**Bei Odoo schätzen wir deine Fähigkeiten mehr als den Lebenslauf.**Ein unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag mit einer 38-Stunden-Woche und einer 6-monatigen Probezeit.

**Bei Odoo schätzen wir deine Fähigkeiten mehr als den Lebenslauf.**

* **Sprachkenntnisse:** Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (C1-C2).
* **Hintergrund:** Ein abgeschlossenes Studium der (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, eine Fachinformatiker-Ausbildung oder eine vergleichbare technische Qualifikation sowie fundierte praktische Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung.

title: Director/Senior Director, Corporates
description:
**Job Description**  
  
As one of the world's top three credit ratings agencies, Fitch Ratings plays a critical role in global capital markets by providing credit analysis, ratings, research, and commentary to financial market participants. For over 100 years, Fitch Ratings has been creating value for global markets through its rigorous analysis and deep expertise, which have resulted in a variety of market leading tools, methodologies, indices, research, and analytical products. Fitch Ratings is part of Fitch Group, a global leader in financial information services with operations in more than 30 countries, which also includes Fitch Solutions. With dual headquarters in London and New York, Fitch Group is owned by Hearst.
  
  
Explore a career at Fitch Ratings and you'll join a collaborative network of curious minds. Here, our differences are our strengths - in life as well as our work. Together we work with integrity and objectivity to provide clarity to the world's financial markets. We pride ourselves on our ability to harness the ideas, expertise, and professionalism of our global workforce, which is integral to our continued success. The accessibility and depth of experience of our industry leading analysts, combined with our broad sector credentials, allow us to help market participants make important credit decisions with confidence.
  
  
**Fitch Ratings is currently seeking a Director/Senior Director based out of our Frankfurt office.**  
  
**About the Team**  
  
The DACH corporate funding landscape is changing faster than at any point in the past decade. German, Austrian and Swiss corporates are broadening their funding mix beyond relationship bank debt and Schuldschein into public bond markets. Sponsor-led financing and private credit continue to expand across the Mittelstand and large-cap segments. Spin-offs, carve-outs and take-privates are creating new entities with new rating needs and new financing structures that require a credible, independent credit opinion.
  
  
Fitch has a clear growth ambition in this market. For the right candidate, this is an great opportunity to join a motivated team, shape its commercial strategy, and build a franchise rather than inherit one.
  
  
**How You'll Make an Impact:**  
  
This is a business origination role within Fitch Ratings' Business & Relationship Management group, covering corporate issuers across Germany, Austria and Switzerland.
  
  
You will generate new rating mandates through two channels: building and deepening relationships with banks and intermediaries (DCM, Syndicate, Origination and Leveraged Finance), and marketing directly to corporate issuers, both rated and unrated. You will also help raise the profile of the Fitch brand through direct engagement, third-party conferences and targeted hosted events.
  
  
The role may additionally involve supporting selected business initiatives in the wider EMEA region.
  
  
**Originate new business**

* Build and maintain a network of intermediaries across investment grade and high yield / leveraged finance who bring Fitch into pitch processes
* Pitch directly to corporate issuer targets, both rated and unrated, across DACH
* Contribute to mapping Fitch's EMEA intermediary coverage, coordinating closely with London-based peers

**Set and execute the regional strategy**

* Understand Fitch's competitive positioning in the non-financial corporates market and translate it into a prioritised target list
* Develop a persuasive, evidence-based case for the value of a Fitch rating, grounded in a working knowledge of the credit rating landscape
* Work independently to develop and implement the commercial strategy for your market

**Manage relationships and execution**

* Act as relationship manager for newly mandated DACH issuers through their first year as Fitch-rated entities, before handover to ongoing portfolio coverage
* Lead commercial execution, including fee negotiation and the preparation of Engagement Letters, Confidentiality Agreements and Hold Harmless Letters
* Partner with Marketing Research Associates on pitchbooks and issuer-facing materials
* Bring creative ideas to market: tailored webinars, sector campaigns and new marketing angles

**You May be a Good Fit if:**

* German at native or near-native level, and excellent English
* A strong understanding of corporate finance and the evolving debt capital markets landscape across investment grade, high yield and leveraged finance - ideally gained in an origination, syndicate or advisory role
* A demonstrable track record of originating new business and developing revenue from both established and self-generated prospect lists
* Excellent communication skills, with the confidence and credibility to engage Treasurers, CFOs and senior bankers
* The ability to work autonomously and own a market end-to-end
* A team-oriented approach, building effective relationships internally as well as externally
* Strong command of Microsoft Office and Salesforce

**What Would Make You Stand Out:**

* Established banker relationships in DACH, both local and international
* Established Treasurer and CFO relationships in DACH, with a contact base beyond the region a further advantage
* Familiarity with the specifics of the German funding market
* An understanding of credit analysis and the role of ratings in capital markets
* A university degree, preferably in a business discipline; a further qualification such as a master's or MBA is welcome

**On title:** This role is open at Director or Senior Director level. The appointed title will reflect depth of experience and the strength of existing market relationships.
  
  
**Why Choose Fitch:**

* **Hybrid Work Environment:** 3 days a week in office required
* **A Culture of Learning & Mobility:** Dedicated trainings, leadership development and mentorship programs designed to ensure that your time at Fitch will be a continuous learning opportunity
* **Investing in Your Future:** Retirement planning and tuition reimbursement programs that empower you to achieve your short and long-term goals
* **Promoting Health & Wellbeing:** Comprehensive healthcare offerings that enable physical, mental, financial, social, and occupational wellbeing
* **Supportive Parenting Policies:** Family-friendly policies, including a generous global parental leave plan, designed to help you balance career and family life effectively
* **Inclusive Work Environment** : A collaborative workplace where all voices are valued, with Employee Resource Groups that unite and empower our colleagues around the globe
* **Dedication to Giving Back:** Paid volunteer days, matched funding for donations and ample opportunities to volunteer in your community

At Fitch, AI is embedded in how we work every day-supporting smarter decision-making, streamlining workflows, and enabling new ways to create value for our business and clients. Intelligent solutions are increasingly part of our day-to-day operations, helping teams work more efficiently and think differently as we continue to evolve. We're looking for colleagues who are comfortable operating in an AI-enabled environment-or who are curious, adaptable, and eager to build their AI literacy over time. We value professionals who embrace technology as part of continuous learning and who are committed to using it thoughtfully to enhance how work gets done.
  
  
Fitch is committed to providing global securities markets with objective, timely, independent and forward-looking credit opinions. To protect Fitch's credibility and reputation, our employees must take every precaution to avoid conflicts of interests or any appearance of a conflict of interest. Should you be successful in the recruitment process at Fitch Ratings you will be asked to declare any securities holdings and other potential conflicts prior to commencing employment. If you, or your immediate family, have any holdings that may conflict with your work responsibilities, you may be asked to divest yourself of them before beginning work.
  
  
Fitch is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. We evaluatequalified applicants without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, and other statuses protected by law.

* Excellent analytical, quantitative and interpretative skills
* The confidence and initiative to take on early responsibility and manage your own projects

description:
Lead Incentive Compensation Analyst

Company Overview

We are a leading global software company dedicated to the world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation— helping innovative global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together while creating a world class software portfolio. Position Overview

Welcome to Foundational Sales – a new global organization at Siemens level. Our mission is to build ONE Sales Fabric: a consistent, scalable, and data-driven go-to-market foundation that empowers our Sales Units to win in their Verticals and markets – and that makes it easier for our customers to do business with Siemens. Our work spans five focus areas – Process & Data Domain, Sales Enablement & Activation, Digital Sales Channel, Vertical Governance & Operations, and Partner Sales. Together, we create the shared standards, systems, and AI-enabled capabilities behind one coordinated face to the customer. Do you want to help redefine how a global tech company sells in the AI era? Then join us – and through radical collaboration and the “Together, unless” principle, help unlock the power of ONE.

Process & Data Domain sets clear common standards for internal-facing processes, data, and the application backbone – acting as the business interface to IT for how common sales applications and related data fit together across the company.

Within it, Global Sales Applications owns the main global sales tools – including Salesforce CRM, ICM / Anaplan, rebate management, and quoting applications – and works with IT DevOps and FS SEA to maintain, improve, roll out, and train users on these applications.

What we offer you: At Siemens, our Total Rewards approach is designed to inspire innovation, reward impact, and support your well-being at every stage of your career. From competitive pay and benefits to recognition and development opportunities, we help you thrive both personally and professionally.

Key Responsibilities

How you will make an impact with us as Incentive Compensation Analyst:

Incentive Compensation Administration

* Administer incentive compensation plans, quotas and crediting rules across Sales Units – supporting accurate compensation calculations, payout execution and dispute resolution in line with agreed governance controls.
* Maintain compensation documentation, plan rules and governance records, ensuring the incentive framework stays current, auditable and aligned with business decisions made by Sales Finance, HR and Sales leadership.
* Configure compensation rules, sales hierarchies, quota assignments and attainment calculations within the incentive management platform, working with IT DevOps to implement and test changes accurately.
* Support annual plan rollouts – coordinating plan communication, compensation statement generation and user onboarding activities across Sales Units.

Platform & Process Management

* Support the incentive management platform (ICM / Anaplan) and related business processes – maintaining system configurations, resolving operational issues and coordinating enhancements with IT DevOps.
* Partner with Salesforce CRM, ERP, Payroll and HR teams to maintain end-to-end process integrity across the incentive compensation lifecycle – from quota assignment and crediting through payout and reconciliation.
* Gather and document business requirements from Sales, Finance and HR, translating compensation plan logic and business rules into platform configurations and process specifications.
* Identify process gaps, data inconsistencies and integration issues between the incentive platform and connected systems, and coordinate resolution with the relevant IT and business stakeholders.

Data, Reporting & User Support

* Monitor compensation, territory and quota data quality – applying governance standards and resolving data issues that could affect calculation accuracy or payout integrity.
* Maintain compensation reports, performance dashboards and payout analytics that give Sales management and Finance clear, timely visibility of incentive outcomes.
* Analyse payout trends, attainment distributions and process exceptions to identify improvement opportunities and support fact-based decisions on compensation plan design.
* Respond to compensation enquiries from sales teams and managers, providing clear, accurate and timely resolution of calculation questions, disputes and plan clarifications.

Qualifications

* Three or more years of experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Compensation Administration, Finance or Commercial Operations, with direct involvement in incentive compensation programs.
* Hands-on experience supporting sales compensation and incentive management processes, including quota management, crediting, attainment calculation, payout execution and dispute resolution.
* Experience with incentive management or planning platforms such as Anaplan, Xactly, Varicent or CaptivateIQ; familiarity with Salesforce CRM is a plus.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience working with large datasets and delivering accurate, timely performance and compensation reporting.
* Confidence working across Sales, Finance, HR and IT teams, with the ability to translate complex compensation logic into clear platform configurations and process documentation.
* University degree in a relevant discipline; advanced degree is a plus. High proficiency in written and spoken English; additional languages are a plus.

You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!

At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world.

You’ll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. title: Staff Product Manager
description:
**What we're building**
-----------------------

Jiga is on a mission to help engineers build physical products faster.

The problem: engineers designing physical products waste weeks chasing quotes, vetting suppliers, and managing procurement instead of actually engineering. Jiga fixes this by connecting engineers directly with vetted manufacturers (CNC, sheet metal, injection molding, 3D printing). Think "npm install for mechanical engineers" - get the parts you need without the admin nightmare.

We're a small, fully-funded, cashflow-positive team serving enterprise customers like NASA, Google, Tesla, and Apple.

**The role**
------------

We're looking for an execution-focused, zero-fluff Staff Product Manager. Someone who can take ownership and drive product initiatives with a high degree of autonomy. You'll be making calls on what we build and why, translating messy customer and operational problems into **simple** solutions, and making sure they're executed well, monitored, and improved over time.

**How we actually work**
------------------------

We’re a small remote team made up of the best of the best. Our team members are distributed around the globe, with product and engineering talent across Europe, Israel, and the US. You’ll also work with teammates in Asia. Most of our work happens async, which is the secret sauce of our success.

**High trust, low bullshit:** We don't count hours or peek over your shoulder on Slack. We trust you to get your work done and tell us when something's wrong. You'll have real ownership over what you build, no process theater, no busy-work meetings.

**Question everything:** See something that doesn't make sense? Say it. Have a better way to do something? Just do it. We actually mean it when we say we want people to challenge the status quo and improve things. Our internal motto is “Don’t drink the kool-aid.”

**No busy work, no fluff:** We keep processes lightweight and practical. If something helps us work better or solve a real problem, we do it. If it creates work without adding value, we question it.

**Actually friendly, not corporate friendly:** We play games online every week (current favorite: Make it Meme). Once a year we fly everyone somewhere beautiful for our offsite. We genuinely like hanging out together, which turns out to be way better than forced "team building exercises."

**What we value in product and engineering:**

**Simple > Complicated.** Simple code, simple architecture. Simple solutions are better than complex ones.

**Ship it, then improve it.** Perfection is the enemy of done. Launch now, iterate forever.

**Product > Engineering.** Every line of code should make our users' lives better. We're not here to show off our algorithmic prowess - we're here to solve real business problems.

**Financials**
--------------

Jiga is fully funded, cashflow positive, with growing revenue MoM. We're completely transparent about our runway and finances - ask us anything.

**What you'll actually do**
---------------------------

* Talk to customers and suppliers, and work closely with internal users to understand their workflows and pain points (not just read reports about them).
* Go deep into a complex problem and come back with a simple solution.
* Analyze and monitor product usage data yourself to inform decisions and measure results.
* Define what we build next and why, then write specs engineers can actually execute on.
* Work closely with engineering and design to take solutions through delivery, follow up after launch, and improve what isn’t working.
* Collaborate with sales, CS, and operations to understand business needs and improve internal processes.
* Take ownership and move things forward independently without exhausting approval loops.
* Clearly communicate what we’re not focusing on and why.
* Use AI throughout all of the above to move faster, go deeper, and get more done.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

**Must have:**

* You've built meaningful products that people use and that drive business results.
* 5+ years in product, including experience owning complex initiatives independently.
* Startup experience (<50 people). You know what “do everything” means.
* Actually hands-on: you've done user research, written specs, built prototypes, and prioritized backlogs yourself. Recently. Not five years ago before you “moved to strategy.”
* Comfortable with data, dashboards, and product analytics. You ask the right questions, find the answers yourself, and question what the numbers are telling you.
* You know what moves the needle, focus on that, and separate real problems from noise.
* You go deep with engineers, communicate clearly in writing, keep stakeholders aligned, and ask users questions that uncover real needs.
* You're willing and able to get into operational details, work with internal teams, and improve how things get done.
* You use AI hands-on in your daily work and have experience building AI-powered features that deliver real value within users’ workflows.
* Strong UI/UX instincts. You have opinions about the details.
* At least 4 hours of overlap with GMT+3 working hours.

**Nice to have:**

* A background in industrial design, mechanical engineering, or supply chain.
* Hands-on experience as a software engineer, data analyst, or UI/UX designer.
* B2B experience in collaboration tools, quoting, supply chain, manufacturing, CAD, logistics, or marketplaces.

**You'll love it here if**
--------------------------

* You're energized by ambiguity, not paralyzed by it. "Figure it out" sounds like freedom, not abandonment.
* You have strong opinions loosely held. You're decisive but update quickly when you're wrong.
* You're low-ego, high-output. You do the grunt work, not just the strategy decks.
* You see gaps and fill them without being asked.
* You say what you think. No corporate speak, no hedging, no "let's circle back."
* "If I can solve this without pulling in a dev, I'll just do it" is how you operate.
* You're obsessively curious about manufacturing and how things get made.

**This might not be for you if**
--------------------------------

* You need meetings to get things moving.
* You prefer clear requirements handed to you.
* You like building consensus before making any decision.
* "Move fast and break things" gives you anxiety.
* You want to focus on "strategy" and have someone else handle the details.
* You can’t operate without a clear process and hierarchy.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* **A small team where you matter:** We never compromise on people. That means you are part of the best team in the world.
* **Zero bureaucracy:** We hate process theatre as much as you do.
* **Real ownership and responsibility:** Make decisions, ship solutions, own the outcomes.
* **Complete flexibility:** Work from anywhere, set your own hours, take time off when you need it (parents especially welcome).
* **Genuinely high trust:** We trust you to do great work and be honest when things go sideways.
* **A team that actually likes each other:** International, diverse, genuinely friendly people who enjoy working together.
* **Generous stock options:** Meaningful equity in the company you’re helping build.
* **Self-development budget** for books, courses, conferences, whatever helps you grow.
* **Annual offsites** in beautiful places.
* **Fast-paced environment** with tons of creative freedom.
* Hard, interesting problems with a **team that's positioned to win big**.

**How to apply**
----------------

Tell us about a product decision you made that was controversial at the time but turned out right. And one that turned out wrong.

* Strong knowledge of **SQL** and **data modeling** (especially star schema).
* Familiarity with **financial systems** (ERP, NetSuite, SAP) and/or experience with **CRM** systems and **customer** **data**.

Nice to have:

* Experience with Claude Code (agents, skills)
* Knowledge of **Power Query** and **Power BI** for data visualization.
* Experience deploying Azure resources like **Azure Container Apps**.

**Soft Skills**

* **Independent Worker**: Ability to operate autonomously while contributing effectively to team goals.
* **Business Acumen**: Strong understanding of business and economic principles, with an ability to apply them in a data context.
* **Analytical Mindset**: Excellent problem-solving and critical thinking skills.
* **Collaborative**: Actively seeks alignment with team members and participates in planning sessions.
* **Quality-Focused**: Committed to reviewing both your own work and that of others to maintain high standards.
* **Strategic Planner**: Consider alternative solutions and refine features before implementation.
* **Purpose-Driven**: Demonstrates a deep understanding of tasks, ensuring they align with business objectives.

**What’s in it for you?**

* Grow your career in a fast-paced and growing organization.
* Enable growth by building a robust and scalable data platform.
* Working with the latest Data Engineering & Data Modeling technologies.
* Long term career opportunities.
* Working from home for up to 4 days per week.
* Flexible work environment with offices around Europe (Netherlands, UK, Spain, France, Poland, Germany).

Interested? We would love to hear from you!

Lass uns gemeinsam loslegen.

**TAWO. THOSE WHO DO.**

**Unsere Mission:** Das industrielle Rückgrat Europas braucht ein Upgrade. Von Rechenzentren über Industrieanlagen bis hin zu Logistikzentren — wir bauen die technische Gebäudeausrüstung, die Fortschritt möglich macht.

Unser Team aus Technikern, Ingenieuren und Tech-Talenten arbeitet als Umsetzungspartner für Europas führende Rechenzentrumsbauer, große Handelsunternehmen und zentrale Energieversorger.

**Starke Partner im Rücken**  
Hinter uns stehen Centrotec, Leadership Datacenter, OBI und einige der bekanntesten Unternehmer und Business Angels aus Bau und Tech.

**Let’s build.**

principles

title: Senior Consultant - Life Sciences Strategy Consulting _ EY Parthenon Mauritius
description:
Location: Ebene

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1763303

Competitive business today is all about making intelligent, informed decisions. As an Associate within EY-Parthenon you will help make that happen. You will be an important part of our diversely talented, highly experienced team.

From Mauritius, we support a uniquely diverse portfolio of life science clients across Africa and EMEIA - from major pharmaceutical companies to biotech labs and public-private partnerships with research and commercial ambition. Our projects can range from defining a comprehensive strategy for the C-Suite, designing operating models for regional laboratories, to supporting companies in their international expansion and governmental and global instances on economic development.

Our practice helps organisations connect scientific innovation with commercial opportunity across African markets. Engagements may span commercial strategy, market entry and access, R&D strategy and portfolio prioritisation, and partnerships that bring together industry, research institutions and governments. The strategic challenge is not simply where to grow, but where to invest, which capabilities to build locally, and how to translate innovation into commercially viable solutions that address health needs.

  

**The opportunity**

In today’s complex business landscape, creativity has become a necessary ingredient for sustained success. EY-Parthenon Strategy has an ideal balance of strengths – deep and concentrated skills with broad executional capabilities, intimate client relationships with larger networks of support, and proven processes along with a progressive spirit to unlock opportunity for our clients, amplify the impact of our strategies, and make EY-Parthenon Strategy the global advisor of choice for business leaders. You have the opportunity to develop your career through a broad scope of engagements, mentoring and formal learning. That’s how we develop outstanding leaders who team to deliver on our promises to all of our stakeholders, and in so doing, play a critical role in building a better working world for our people, for our clients and for our communities.

Joining EY-Parthenon Mauritius means contributing to one of the fastest-growing strategy practices focused on Africa. It is an opportunity to shape high-impact strategies, work directly with senior decision-makers, and play an active role in driving transformation across the continent, combining intellectual rigor, entrepreneurial energy, and real on-the-ground impact.

**This role offers the opportunity to explore the intersection of life sciences, business and economic development: helping shape commercial and R&D strategies that reflect the needs of distinct African markets, assessing opportunities across pharmaceuticals, biotechnology and health technologies, and considering how research, manufacturing and commercial partnerships can create sustainable value.**

Joining EY-Parthenon Mauritius means contributing to **an Africa-focused strategy practice**, working directly with senior decision-makers and helping shape high-impact strategies across the continent. **You will combine intellectual rigour and entrepreneurial energy with an understanding of local realities, helping clients make choices that balance commercial ambition, innovation and wider health and economic impact.**

**What’s in it for you?**

* You will gain a unique global and Africa-focused exposure across Mauritius, Ghana, Ethiopia, Madagascar, Kenya, Rwanda, South Africa, Côte d'Ivoire, and beyond.

* You will take on a strategic role at the intersection of leadership alignment, culture, operations, and human performance.

* You will work directly with C-suite executives, sponsors, and business leaders.

* You will benefit from accelerated career growth within a fast-expanding strategy practice.

* You will have access to EY’s global transformation frameworks, accelerators, and learning programmes.
* You will have access to EY’s global life sciences network

* You will join an entrepreneurial environment where you help shape and scale the transformation capabilities of the Mauritius practice

  

**Skills and attributes for success**

* Performing secondary research using a variety of sources (e.g., analyst reports, market research reports, news articles)
* Executing various analyses (e.g., commercial strategy, launch strategy, customer segmentation, market sizing, competitor analysis, macroeconomic forecasting) to support the strategic recommendations
* Designing and executing in-depth interview guides with key organizational stakeholders, industry experts and customers
* Reviewing business plans to identify key assumptions and drivers

  

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* A bachelor’s degree in life sciences, with minors in business, economics or finance, or STEM
* 2-3 years of experience in life science strategy consulting or a related field
* Outstanding academic performance, including coursework relevant to the position, preferably including quantitative courses in mathematics, business, economics, biological sciences or engineering
* Ideally some related work experience through internships
* Demonstrated interest in related fields through internships, coursework or extracurricular activities
* A strong aptitude for quantitative and qualitative research and analysis
* Proficient in English and French, including the ability to listen, understand, read and communicate effectively both in writing and verbally in a professional environment
* Willingness to travel to meet client obligations

  

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Excellent problem solving, project management, facilitation and interpersonal skills.

* Willing and able to learn and work independently with minimal supervision
* Effective organization and time management skills with ability to work under pressure and adhere to project deadlines
* Able to multitask and work efficiently in a fast-paced environment

As a global leader in Assurance, Consulting, Strategy and Transactions, Tax, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. title: Senior FP&A Analyst (m/f/d)
description:
Tutzing

Full-time

Permanent employee

**Position Overview:**
----------------------

Lobster DATA is a PE-backed B2B software company near Munich with around 280 employees. Our integration platform connects the systems of companies across Europe, and we are growing internationally.

As Senior FP&A Analyst you are the commercial finance partner for the leadership team. You own business cases, the analysis of our SaaS metrics, the rolling forecast and the budget preparation. You work alongside our Controller, who owns actuals and closing-related reporting. You report to the Finance Director and work closely with the CFO and CEO and our leadership team. We are building a finance function that runs on data pipelines, SQL and AI tools rather than manual spreadsheets, and we want someone who uses that infrastructure to answer commercial questions faster and helps shape where it goes next.

**You’ll get to take ownership of:**
------------------------------------

* Build business cases and scenario analyses for pricing, hiring, investments and new markets.
* Track and explain our SaaS metrics: ARR, ACV, net revenue retention, churn and the ARR bridge.
* Act as a sparring partner for department heads on their numbers, and challenge assumptions when they do not hold.
* Work independently on strategic and operational topics and support the leadership team with clear analyses and recommendations.
* Own the annual budget preparation and the rolling forecast, from the driver model to the final numbers presented to the board.
* Add the commercial and strategic view to management and board reporting, working with our Controller, who owns actuals and budget-versus-actual analysis.
* Support investor reporting with financial analyses and ad hoc requests.
* Use our data infrastructure (SQL, automated data flows and AI tools) to get answers faster, and tell our finance automation team what to build next.

**What You’ll Bring:**
----------------------

* 3 to 6 years in FP&A, controlling, transaction services, investment banking or a comparable analytical role.
* Strong commercial judgement: you understand how revenue, pricing and cost decisions show up in the P&L and in cash, and you can explain it to non-finance colleagues.
* Confident financial modelling, including driver-based planning and scenarios.
* Working knowledge of SQL, or the clear intent to become fluent quickly. You prefer pulling data yourself over waiting for an export.
* Practical use of AI tools in your analytical work, with a sound sense of where their output needs checking.
* Fluent English. German is a strong plus.
* A degree in business, economics, finance or a quantitative subject, or equivalent experience.

**Nice to Have:**

* Python for data analysis (pandas or similar).
* Experience with M&A processes, due diligence or other transaction work.
* Experience in a B2B SaaS or software company, ideally PE-backed.
* Familiarity with HubSpot, DATEV and ideally Lucanet or a similar cloud-based reporting tool.

**You can look forward to:**
----------------------------

**The role is based at our office in Tutzing near Munich, with at least two (2) days a week on site. The rest of the week you can work remotely.**  

* Direct exposure to the CFO, the leadership team and our investor from day one.
* A finance team that builds its own tools, with room for you to shape planning and reporting.
* Modern offices in Germany and the Netherlands
* A personal Learning & Development budget
* Up to 30 days of remote work per year from any EU country
* 2 additional paid days off on Christmas Eve and New Year's Eve
* Company Pension plan
* 30 vacation days a year
* Company-sponsored business travel

**About us**
------------

Lobster is the go-to data integration platform for complex, multi-party supply chains. It connects suppliers, partners and systems across EDI, APIs, legacy databases, AI and more – with 90+ pre-built connectors, 2000+ customers and 20 years of supply chain expertise. Lobster empowers teams to build their own integrations with visibility and control at every step. Data gets enriched along the way, using workflows, exception handling and human input where needed. Purpose-built for logistics, manufacturing and retail, Lobster helps organizations reduce integration complexity, respond faster when requirements change, and keep their supply chain data flowing as operations evolve.

title: Audit Specialist (Open to all applicants).
description:
**Tiered Approach**

In line with the commitment to safeguard capacity and support personnel already in the Organization, a majority of UNDP UNCDF/UNV vacancies are advertised using a tiered application process whereby:

* **Tier 0** : UNDP/UNCDF/UNV IP staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments, whose posts will be abolished, or contracts will be terminated or not renewed during 2026.
* **Tier 1** : Other UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments
* **Tier 2** : UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding temporary appointments (TA), personnel on regular PSA contracts, and Expert and Specialist UN Volunteers
* **Tier 3 or no tier indicated** : All other contract types from UNDP/UNCDF/UNV and other agencies, and other external candidates

Please make note of the Tier(s) indicated in the vacancy title, if any, and ensure that you satisfy the eligibility to apply.

**Background**

The Office of Audit and Investigations (OAI) reports to the Administrator and is responsible for providing internal audit and investigations services to UNDP and its affiliated entities. OAI provides independent, objective assurance on the effectiveness of risk management and the effectiveness and adequacy of internal controls. As part of its assurance work, OAI also supports the annual audit exercise of non-governmental/nationally implemented projects (HACT/NIM projects) in some 150 countries where UNDP operates, reviews, and analyses the resulting audit reports submitted by audit firms and government audit institutions.

OAI has a decentralized organizational structure with the Directorate and headquarter units based in New York, and Regional Oversight Centers (ROCs) located in seven regions: Bonn (Germany), Kuala Lumpur (Malaysia), Nairobi (Kenya), Pretoria (South Africa), Dakar (Senegal), Panama City (Panama) and Istanbul (Turkey).

The Headquarters Audit Section (HAS) is situated in the Regional Oversight Center in Bonn, Germany. It is staffed with a Chief (P-5 level), seven Audit Specialist (P-4 and P-3), an Audit Analyst (P-2), and one Administrative Associate (G-6 level). The workforce is at times supplemented with junior professionals, personnel on secondment or loan to OAI or contracted resources.

The Audit Specialist reports to the Chief of HAS. The role of the audit specialist is to primarily lead the audits of corporate business units, corporate systems and functions that are in the audit universe of HAS. At times, this may include undertaking audit assignments in areas with hardship or hazardous working conditions.

**Position Purpose**

The Headquarters Audit Section (HAS) covers corporate business units as well as corporate systems and functions. The primary role of the Audit Specialist is to lead the performance of internal audits of these units, systems and functions.

UNDP adopts a portfolio approach to accommodate changing business needs and leverage linkages across interventions to achieve its strategic goals. Therefore, UNDP personnel are expected to work across units, functions, teams, and projects in multidisciplinary teams in order to enhance and enable horizontal collaboration.

**Duties and Responsibilities**

1.) Ensure and Lead Management Functions
  

* As a team leader, assumes responsibility and accountability for achieving the audit objectives. This involves:

 Preparation of risk-based audit plans/programmes.
  
 Conduct of audit field work.
  
 Preparation and review of working papers.
  
 Preparation of Exit Meeting notes.
  
 Preparation of draft audit reports, incorporating input from other team members.

* Assesses the team members’ performance in a participatory manner and documents lessons learned.
* Provides direction and guidance to, and coaches team members ensuring effective team functioning.
* Presents audit results to management.
* Monitors the status of audit recommendations and appraises adequacy of action taken on audit recommendations.
* Acts as Officer-in-Charge for HAS when necessary.

2.) Lead Effective Client Services
  

* As a team leader or as a member of an audit team, conducts audit assignments in accordance with the International Standards for the Professional Practice of Internal Auditing as published by the Institute of Internal Audit and OAI policy guidelines.
* Assesses the adequacy and effectiveness of internal controls and risk management.
* Documents findings and communicates orally and/or in writing to the country offices on their compliance, performance, and potential for improvement.
* Recommends actions to address shortcomings identified, strengthen internal controls and improve business processes.
* Under the overall supervision of the Chief, conducts special assignments including management reviews, consulting assignments, special audits, and training workshops.
* Undertakes missions to UNDP offices as required.
* Plans and oversees the engagement of audit firms for annual audits or special purpose audits as required.

3.) Performs other tasks as required by the Chief or OAI Director and facilitate knowledge sharing
  

* Contributes to the ongoing development of professional practices within OAI.
* Participates in the implementation of his/ her personal learning and training development plan.
* Performs other assignments or tasks as determined by OAI Director or the HAS chief.

The incumbent performs other duties within their functional profile as deemed necessary for the efficient functioning of the Office and the Organization
  
Supervisory/Managerial Responsibilities: Incumbent supervises personnel assigned to audit missions under their leadership

**Competencies**

* **Core Competencies:**

**Achieve Results:** LEVEL 3: Set and align challenging, achievable objectives for multiple projects, have lasting impact

**Think Innovatively:** LEVEL 3: Proactively mitigate potential risks, develop new ideas to solve complex problems

**Learn Continuously:** LEVEL 3: Create and act on opportunities to expand horizons, diversify experiences

**Adapt with Agility:** LEVEL 3: Proactively initiate and champion change, manage multiple competing demands

**Act with Determination:** LEVEL 3: Think beyond immediate task/barriers and take action to achieve greater results

**Engage and Partner:** LEVEL 3: Political savvy, navigate complex landscape, champion inter-agency collaboration

**Enable Diversity and Inclusion:** LEVEL 3: Appreciate benefits of diverse workforce and champion inclusivity

* **Cross-Functional & Technical competencies:**

**Business Direction and Strategy-System Thinking:** Ability to use objective problem analysis and judgement to understand how interrelated elements coexist within an overall process or system, and to consider how altering one element can impact on other parts of the system.

**Business Management-Portfolio Management:**

* Ability to select, prioritise and control the organization's programmes and projects in line with its strategic objectives and capacity
* Ability to balance the implementation of change initiatives with regular activities for optimal return on investment.
* Knowledge and understanding of key principles of project, programme, and portfolio management

**Business Direction Strategy & Negotiation and influence:** Reach a common understanding/agreement, persuade others, resolve points of difference through a dialogue, negotiate mutually acceptable solutions and create ‘win-win’ situations.

**Audit & Investigation & Audit Internal auditing standards, practices, and techniques:** Knowledge of key notions and concepts, practices, and
  
methodologies of internal auditing (Global Internal Audit Standards and Other IIA Standards, COSO). Undertake audit assignments in accordance with international professional standards in respect of operational audits, financial audits, performance audits, project audits and provision of advisory service.

**Audit & Investigation – Audit Critical creative and foresight applied to audit and investigations:** Possesses essential critical thinking and foresight capacity to analyze facts to form a judgment.

**Audit & Investigation – Audit Performance key concepts and techniques:** Ability to understand and use various concepts such as efficiency, effectiveness and economy.

**Audit & Investigation - Audit Fraud awareness and investigation techniques:** Basic knowledge to understand the foundations of fraud, how to detect red flags and conduct initial fact findings.

**Required Skills and Experience**

**Education:**

* Advanced University degree (master’s degree or equivalent) in Accounting, Auditing, Law, Finance, Business Administration, Statistics, Public Administration, Engineering or related fields is required. Or
* A First level university degree (bachelor’s degree) in the above fields with an additional 2 years of experience will be given due consideration in lieu of the advanced university degree
* Chartered Accountant or Certified Public Accountant designation or Certification as a Certified Internal Auditor (CIA) are desirable.
* Certification as Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE), Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA) or equivalent are an advantage.

**Experience:**

* A minimum of 7 years (with master’s degree) or 9 years (with bachelor’s degree) of professional experience in audit or another directly relevant area, of which several in internal audit (planning, leading, and undertaking internal audit assignments) is required.
* At least 3 years as an audit team leader is desired.
* At least 3 years conducting a variety of operational, or performance audits or implementing performance improvement activities is desired.
* Working experience in International Organization is desirable.
* Working experience in Major Audit Firms or Supreme Audit Institution is desirable.
* Experience assessing the adequacy and effectiveness of internal controls and risk management is an asset.

**Languages:**

* Fluency in English is required.
* Working Knowledge of another UN language is desirable.

**Equal opportunity**

As an equal opportunity employer, UNDP values diversity as an expression of the multiplicity of nations and cultures where we operate and, as such, we encourage qualified applicants from all backgrounds to apply for roles in the organization. Our employment decisions are based on merit and suitability for the role, without discrimination.

UNDP is also committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all personnel are empowered to contribute to our mission, are valued, can thrive, and benefit from career opportunities that are open to all.

**Sexual harassment, exploitation, and abuse of authority**

UNDP does not tolerate harassment, sexual harassment, exploitation, discrimination and abuse of authority. All selected candidates, therefore, undergo relevant checks and are expected to adhere to the respective standards and principles.

**Probation**

For all new UNDP fixed term appointments (FTA), including for staff members being transferred or seconded to UNDP under the Inter-Organization Agreement concerning Transfer, Secondment or Loan of Staff, on an appointment of more than one year, continuation of the appointment beyond the initial 12 months is contingent upon the successful completion of a probationary period.

**Right to select multiple candidates**

UNDP reserves the right to select one or more candidates from this vacancy announcement. We may also retain applications and consider candidates applying to this post for other similar positions with UNDP at the same grade level and with similar job description, experience and educational requirements.

**Use of AI by candidates**

Applicants are invited to read UNDP’s guidance for candidates on using AI responsibly in UNDP recruitment and selection

**Scam alert**

UNDP does not charge a fee at any stage of its recruitment process. For further information, please see www.undp.org/scam-alert.

Trusted by 20,000+ property managers worldwide, Hostaway is an industry leading, AI-powered vacation rental management platform designed for professional short-term rental operators. Hostaway brings everything together for greater efficiency and faster growth.

Profitable, high-growth, and the first short-term rental PMS unicorn . Join us at our most exciting stage yet! Learn more about our recent valuation and story here.

At Hostaway we are building the financial heart of the platform. Our aim over the coming years is one accounting product that meets the rules of every market our customers work in, and to go further, owning how money moves through our customers' businesses.

Few product managers get to build something this important almost from the start, in a profitable unicorn already. You will own it end to end: setting the direction, shaping it from an early stage, and working closely with our C-level executive team.

We're building the sales engine for Tellent HR in the DACH market, and we're looking for an Account Executive to help us do it. Think of it as joining a startup inside a scale-up.

First and foremost, this is a hands-on selling role. You'll own the full sales cycle for Tellent HR (Manage and/or Grow), split roughly 80/20 between new business and expansion into our existing customer base. Inbound isn't going to be your main pipeline driver, so expect to spend around 50% of your time prospecting, against ambitious daily and weekly activity targets. Alongside that, you'll help us work out *how* we win in DACH: testing motions fast and doubling down on what drives revenue.

You'll work with a dedicated Product Marketing Manager and Customer Success Manager in the Tellent HR squad. CS capacity is limited, though, so you'll run deals independently, including demos and follow-through.

#### **Your 12-Month Journey**

* **First 3 months:** Learn Tellent HR, our ideal customers and the competitive landscape in DACH. Build your first pipeline through outbound, establish a consistent daily activity rhythm, and close your first deals.
* **Within 6 months:** Consistently hit your activity, pipeline and revenue targets, understand which sales motions work best in the DACH market, and feed insights back to Product Marketing and Product.
* **After 1 year:** Be the go-to expert on selling Tellent HR in DACH, with a repeatable, data-backed playbook that others can pick up.

#### **What You'll Be Doing**

* **Own the full sales cycle, independently:** Run 1–3 month, multi-stakeholder deals involving HR leaders, founders/CEOs and Finance, from first touch through to close and follow-through.
* **Hunt for new pipeline (around 50% of your time):** Prospect by phone, email and LinkedIn, consistently hit your daily and weekly activity targets, and maintain 3–4x pipeline coverage. Partner, CS and marketing leads are a bonus, not the plan.
* **Drive expansion:** Prospect into existing Tellent customers to cross-sell and upsell, e.g. Recruitee customers adding Tellent HR, or Manage customers adding Grow.
* **Sell on value:** Run consultative discovery and tailored demos, position on business outcomes, and handle objections, including against key competitors (with support from PMM).
* **Manage deals with discipline:** Use mutual action plans, keep HubSpot accurate (including SPICED), forecast reliably and disqualify early.
* **Test and build, alongside selling:** Experiment with sales motions, sequences and verticals, help build the playbook with our PMM, and bring customer and competitive insights from the DACH market back to Product and Marketing.

#### **What You Bring**

* **Early-stage DNA:** You've sold in a startup or early scale-up and built pipeline and processes where none existed. You know what it means to be an early sales hire.
* **Proven hunter:** A track record of self-generating pipeline through outbound and consistently hitting ambitious activity targets. You genuinely enjoy picking up the phone and creating opportunities from scratch.
* **B2B SaaS sales experience:** You've closed new business (ideally expansion too) as a fully autonomous AE in a startup or early scale-up, running 1–5 month, multi-stakeholder sales cycles. HR tech experience is a plus, not essential.
* **Self-sufficient and resilient:** You don't wait for leads, support teams or perfect processes. You bounce back from rejection and stay disciplined through the ups and downs of building something new.
* **Consultative and data-driven:** Strong discovery, demo and negotiation skills. You anchor on value before price and know your numbers (pipeline, conversion, win rate and cycle time).
* **Languages:** Fluent English and native or fluent German are required. You'll be responsible for engaging customers and building relationships across the DACH market.

This role probably isn't for you if you want a structured environment with large support teams and steady inbound, or you're more excited by GTM strategy than by picking up the phone every day.

#### **How We Measure Success**

* Closed-won revenue against target (primary KPI)
* Daily and weekly outbound activity targets (key leading indicator, especially early on)
* Self-generated pipeline and coverage
* Win rate, deal velocity and forecast accuracy
* Contributions to the playbook

#### **What We Offer**

* **Compensation:** €55000–€70000 gross annual base salary, **plus commission**.
* **Ownership and impact:** Real autonomy to shape the sales motion, playbook and market strategy for a growing product line.
* **Hybrid working:** Work from our canal-side Amsterdam office 2–3 days per week.
* **International environment:** Join a diverse and international team working across multiple markets.
* **Learning & Development:** €1,500 annual learning budget and 2 dedicated learning days.
* **Pension & Wellness:** Pension plan and wellness perks.
* **Time Off:** 28 paid holiday days, plus 2 additional days in 2026.
* **Work from Anywhere:** Work from anywhere for up to 4 weeks per year.
* **Commuting:** Commuting and travel reimbursement.
* **Home Office:** €200 home office budget and a work-from-home allowance.
* **Equipment:** Apple MacBook and all the tools you need to succeed.

*Please note: Benefits may differ based on your employment location.*

#### **About Tellent**

Tellent is the people decision platform that empowers HR teams and leaders to turn employee data into connected, intelligent guidance, enabling proactive, consistent, and human-centered people management at scale. Built on the combined foundations of Recruitee, KiwiHR, and Javelo, Tellent offers an integrated platform to help organisations hire, manage, and grow their teams.

Serving more than 7,000 organisations across Benelux, DACH, France, and other international markets, Tellent’s modular platform covers the full employee lifecycle: from hiring and HR operations to performance, engagement, and embedded people intelligence.

Tellent is recognised as a Core Leader in the 2026 Fosway 9-Grid™ for Talent Acquisition and a Solid Performer in the 2026 Fosway 9-Grid™ for Cloud HR — the only European-centric analyst framework that evaluates HR and talent solutions across Performance, Potential, Market Presence, Total Cost of Ownership, and Trajectory.

Founded in 2022 and headquartered in Amsterdam, Tellent is a private, PE-backed company with more than 240 employees.

#### **AI in Our Recruitment Process**

We use our internally developed AI tools to help streamline our recruitment process. However, technology never makes a decision. Every candidate is personally reviewed by our team. Your journey with us is guided by people, supported by tech. Curious about how it works? Read our AI Statement, check our Privacy Policy, or chat with us at hr@tellent.com.

title: Senior Manager, Business Operations & Strategy (Pricing)
description:
### **Change the way the world travels**

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours.

Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

### **Team mission**

Our mission is to offer the world’s most comprehensive, curated selection. Pricing is a key lever for this. The pricing team drives profitable, sustainable growth by owning and optimizing GetYourGuide’s global pricing strategy. We establish a data-driven framework for pricing and commission decisions, ensure highly competitive positioning, and balance operator partnership, customer acquisition, and margin health. We are turning pricing from a function into a strategic asset that defines our market leadership.

### **About the role**

As a Senior Business Operations & Strategy Manager on the pricing team, you will help shape and execute pricing and commission strategy for our global marketplace. You will build frameworks, analytical foundations, and ways of working that enable data-driven pricing decisions and deliver optimal value for both suppliers and customers.

### **Your mission**

* Drive our commercial pricing strategy together with the Head of Pricing, translating company growth objectives into actionable pricing and commission levers and initiatives.
* Develop and continuously improve commission structures, discount programs, and incentive models so that supplier success aligns with marketplace goals.
* Work with data scientists and analysts to build dashboards and performance tracking, and to identify and prioritize optimization opportunities across markets and categories.
* Gather and act on competitive pricing insights, and build frameworks and playbooks for fair and competitive pricing that foster customer trust and productive supplier relationships.
* Collect structured input from commercial teams across regions and work with product managers to turn it into prioritized improvements to pricing platforms and tooling.
* Act as a key commercial voice for pricing, providing actionable insights and engaging senior stakeholders to influence decisions.

### **Your toolkit**

* 4+ years of experience in Strategy, Business Operations, Revenue Management, Analytics, or Pricing roles (mid-level candidates with strong foundations are welcome to apply). Experience in a fast-paced tech, marketplace, or SaaS setting is highly preferred.
* Solid understanding of pricing strategy, optimization, and revenue management in the context of marketplace dynamics.
* High analytical skill, with the ability to turn commercial and pricing data into clear strategic recommendations (SQL, Looker, PowerBI, Tableau, or similar).

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours.

Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

### **Team mission**

Landing pages are one of GetYourGuide's most important product surfaces — the moment where acquisition meets experience, and where the quality of what we build directly determines whether a visitor becomes a customer.

### **Your mission**

As Lead Product Manager for Landing Pages, you will own a high-traffic surface that sits at the intersection of growth, acquisition, and user experience. You will work closely with paid search, paid media, and SEO stakeholders to ensure the pages you build perform across channels, while keeping the traveller's needs at the centre of every decision. Your cross-functional team includes engineers, designers, analysts, and researchers.

This is a role for someone who thinks in systems, is energised by the product-marketing boundary, and wants to build something that scales — not just ship features. The work has direct visibility into how GetYourGuide grows, and the decisions made here have a measurable impact on the business from day one.

We are looking for a Lead PM who brings both strategic clarity and executional rigour — someone who can set a vision, bring stakeholders along, and deliver.

### **What You'll Do**

* Build modular, reusable infrastructure — page templates, content modules, and page logic — that compounds in value over time. You are not optimising individual features; you are building the foundation that makes everything that follows faster and cheaper.
* Develop and implement a strategy for your product area, set clear measurable goals, and take full responsibility for outcomes. Connect your roadmap to the company's mission, break it into actionable steps, and create genuine excitement for the long-term vision — with your team, across functions, and with executive leadership.
* Apply your understanding of acquisition channel economics and how landing page content drives channel performance. Partner closely with paid search, paid media, and SEO stakeholders to ensure pages serve channel needs without being built around any single one. Hold user experience and channel performance goals together rather than trading them off.
* Design and own an experimentation system at scale — not just individual A/B tests, but the architecture and cadence that enables rapid, parallel testing across page types and channels. Build toward a model that increases the speed and independence of experimentation over time.
* Use customer feedback, market trends, and business metrics to drive decisions. Prioritise ruthlessly, re-evaluate the roadmap as new insights arrive, and make clear calls on sequencing to maximise both impact and learning.
* Represent customer interests at all levels of the organisation. Act with openness and transparency with your team, peers, and leadership. Coach and mentor team members, foster a culture of continuous improvement, and bring others along on the vision.

### **Your toolkit**

* **6+ years of experience in product management**, with a**t least 2 years as a Lead or Senior PM owning a product area end-to-end** — including strategy, goal-setting, roadmap execution, and KPI accountability.
* A systems thinker who builds for scale. You have experience building product infrastructure or platforms — not just features — and you understand how foundational work compounds over time.
* Experience working at the intersection of product and marketing, growth, or acquisition. You have a working understanding of how channels like paid search, paid social, or SEO use product surfaces to drive performance, and you're comfortable holding user experience and channel performance goals together.
* Strong analytical skills with demonstrated experience in experimentation — designing testing methodology and cadence, not just interpreting results. You know how to build a testing culture and move a team toward data-informed decisions at speed.
* Proven ability to build alignment across engineering, design, analytics, and marketing stakeholders. You bring people along through clear thinking and strong communication rather than through authority.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. You can translate complex product and technical concepts for executive, marketing, and engineering audiences equally well.
* **Bonus:** Experience in a marketplace, e-commerce, or travel business.
* **Bonus:** A background in engineering or data science — particularly valuable given the technical architecture nature of this role.

------------

Data is at the heart of how we grow, optimize, and innovate our e-commerce business at Canyon. As a Data Analyst in our Digital department, you combine data expertise with business acumen to turn customer behavior and multi-channel performance data into actionable insights that drive conversion, funnel efficiency, and commercial growth across our webshop and acquisition channels. You work with data from Digital, Marketing, Sales, and Business Intelligence to build analyses, dashboards, and enable decision-making at scale.

The position is located at our headquarters in **Koblenz, Germany** , where you will work at least three days a week.

**YOUR JOB AS PART OF THE CANYON CREW**
---------------------------------------

* **Business Partnership & Insights:** Partner with business stakeholders to scope analytical use cases and deliver structured, data-driven solutions. Translate your insights into clear business recommendations and presentations, including for C-level audiences.

* **Acquisition & Marketing Analytics:** Conduct deep-dive analyses of customer acquisition and marketing effectiveness, including ads interaction, SEO ranking, email performance, and campaign conversion rates using data from Google Ads, Meta, Google Search Console, and Salesforce Marketing Cloud.
* **Customer & Commercial Analytics:** Analyze CRM and ERP data to understand customer segments, repurchase rates, product performance, and profitability using data from Salesforce CRM and SAP.
* **Dashboards & Reporting:** Design, build, and maintain automated dashboards and scalable reporting tools for non-technical business users.
* **Data Preparation & Quality:** Perform advanced data preparation, SQL scripting, and transformations across complex datasets in BigQuery and dbt while ensuring data accuracy and integrity through validation rules, QA processes, and source-to-report consistency checks.
* **Google Analytics:** Maintain our Google Analytics system, including property management, event and dimension definitions, and training for business users.
* **Data Infrastructure:** Partner with data engineers and data scientists to continuously evolve our data tools and infrastructure.

**HOW YOU BECOME PART OF THE RACE**

* **Professional Experience:** 2–5 years of hands-on experience as a Data Analyst, Web Analyst, or Analytics Engineer in an e-commerce or digital environment.

title: Full Stack Software Engineer
description:
WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK
  
  
We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times.
  
  
Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH
  
  
As the premier consulting partner for the private equity industry, Bain's PEG boasts a global practice that is over three times larger than any competitor. Our network of over 1,000 professionals supports private equity and institutional investor clients through every stage of the investment life cycle, from deal generation and due diligence to portfolio value creation and exit planning.
  
  
Bain & Company is developing a suite of cutting-edge data and software solutions designed to revolutionize how the private equity industry uses data for investment insights and decision-making.
  
  
The PEG Innovation team's mission is to create analytical solutions for Bain clients, teams, and the broader institutional investor space using proprietary software and data products. This includes the development, commercialization, and daily management of Bain's proprietary datasets, data, and software businesses.
  
  
WHERE YOU’LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM
  
  
Full Stack Software Engineers build, ship, and operate the end-to-end products and shared platform services that power Bain's PE due diligence platform within PEG Engineering. You work across the entire stack: responsive React and Svelte frontends styled with Tailwind, Node.js (TypeScript, Express) and Python (FastAPI) backend services, RESTful and type-safe APIs, PostgreSQL data models, and the scheduled and event-driven jobs that keep data flowing. Our environment is deliberately polyglot and fast-moving, and we expect this engineer to be comfortable moving across languages, frameworks, and layers rather than staying in one lane.
  
  
**A significant portion of this work is AI-enabled:** integrating LLMs and agentic patterns into real analyst workflows through retrieval pipelines, structured outputs, streaming interfaces, and human-in-the-loop review. We weight strong engineering fundamentals as the foundation and treat AI as a reviewed co-pilot, not an autopilot. This is an engineering role in the full sense, we expect you to understand the problem, weigh approaches, and own the design and the outcome, not only produce code. AI accelerates the implementation, the engineering judgement behind it stays with you. Every AI-assisted change is expected to be understood, validated, and owned by the engineer who commits it.
  
  
You are expected to deliver production-quality code, write tests for the workflows you build, own features end-to-end, and partner with Product and Design to turn requirements into reliable user experiences. Engineers operate with increasing independence and breadth across the grade: earlier in the grade with guidance from senior engineers on the most complex or ambiguous work, and toward the upper end owning delivery independently, leading implementation of features, and providing technical guidance to peers and more junior engineers. Most of our systems run on Microsoft Azure, with some workloads on AWS. You collaborate with Platform Engineering for shared services such as Auth/RBAC, Audit, Notifications, and File handling, and with the AI teams to integrate intelligent features safely and correctly.
  
  
WHAT YOU'LL DO
  
  
Product and Platform Delivery Across the Full Stack (80%)
  

* Build and maintain product UI features in React and Svelte with TypeScript and Tailwind, following established component patterns and the shared design system.
* Build and maintain backend services in Python (FastAPI, Pydantic v2) and Node.js (TypeScript, Express), following established code conventions and PR standards.
* Design and implement RESTful and type-safe API contracts (Zod, Pydantic, OpenAPI codegen, or similar); own the contract boundary between frontend and backend services and manage consumer impact when it changes.
* Model and evolve PostgreSQL schemas via SQLAlchemy and equivalent patterns; write safe, backwards-compatible migrations using the expand/contract approach.
* Build and operate scheduled and event-driven jobs (cron-based and queue-driven systems) for ingestion, enrichment, and background processing; make them idempotent, observable, and safe to re-run.
* Integrate AI-enabled features into product workflows: LLM calls, retrieval-augmented generation, vector search, structured and streaming outputs, and human-in-the-loop review, following established safety and evaluation patterns.
* Integrate correctly with shared platform services (Auth/RBAC, Audit, Notifications, File handling); raise contract issues early and coordinate changes through the teams.
* Write unit and integration tests for delivered features (Vitest and React Testing Library on the frontend, pytest and Jest on the backend) and contribute to end-to-end tests (Playwright) for owned workflows.
* Add observability for owned changes: follow established logging patterns, emit standard metrics, and update dashboards and runbooks for impacted workflows.
* Contribute to containerized delivery (Docker) and support Kubernetes configuration through Helm values and manifests; deploy primarily to Azure, with some workloads on AWS.
* Support releases for owned work: validate changes in staging, participate in incident triage, and follow runbooks and escalation paths.

Technical Contribution, Collaboration, and Growth (35%)
  

* Participate fully in team ceremonies (refinement, planning, standup, review, retro); ask clarifying questions early and communicate blockers clearly.
* Participate in code reviews as both author and reviewer; incorporate feedback and raise code quality over time.
* Provide technical guidance to peers and mentor more junior engineers through review and pairing (expected toward the upper end of the grade).
* Contribute to engineering standards, reusable patterns, and shared product infrastructure (design system, API client libraries, OpenAPI and type generation).
* Contribute to technical discovery, proofs-of-concept, and evaluation of new tools and techniques, including emerging AI engineering practices.
* Use AI coding assistants to accelerate scaffolding, refactors, and first-pass tests; read, understand, and validate all generated code before committing.
* Contribute documentation for delivered features (release notes, runbook updates, and lightweight technical notes) as part of the Definition of Done.

ABOUT YOU
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience).
* 2 to 5 years of professional experience building and shipping web applications and backend services in a production environment, with greater independence, breadth, and ownership expected toward the upper end of the grade.
* Demonstrated experience implementing features in modern TypeScript frameworks (React and/or Svelt) and writing tests for shipped work.
* Experience building backend APIs and services in Python (FastAPI) and/or Node.js (TypeScript, Express), and working with relational databases including schema evolution and migrations.
* Comfortable working productively across a polyglot codebase (Python and TypeScript) rather than a single language or layer.
* Production exposure to a major cloud provider (Microsoft Azure and/or AWS).
* Exposure to building or integrating AI-enabled features (LLM integration, retrieval, structured outputs), grounded in solid software engineering fundamentals.
* Comfortable collaborating with Product and Design to translate requirements into working software and iterating on feedback.

Full-Stack Product Engineering
  

* Frontend fundamentals in TypeScript with React and/or Svelte: component composition, state management, and performance-aware UI development; comfortable styling with Tailwind and a shared design system.
* Frontend testing: Vitest and React Testing Library (or equivalent); able to write reliable unit and integration tests and debug failures.
* Backend fundamentals in Python (FastAPI, Pydantic v2, async patterns) and/or Node.js (TypeScript, Express); able to build and maintain well-structured services under established conventions.
* API design and validation: RESTful services with validated and type-safe contracts (Zod, Pydantic, OpenAPI codegen, or similar); understands versioning and backwards compatibility.
* Relational data fundamentals: comfortable writing and reading raw SQL, designing normalized schemas, and reasoning about tables, views, indexes, and foreign-key relationships rather than relying solely on ORM-generated patterns.
* Working PostgreSQL knowledge: query plan analysis when debugging slow queries, JSONB usage patterns, and the ability to reason about triggers and stored procedures where the team uses them.
* Migration discipline: writes safe, backwards-compatible migrations following the expand/contract approach; understands why breaking changes are dangerous in a multi-service environment.
* Scheduled and event-driven systems: comfortable building and operating cron-based and queue-driven jobs, with attention to idempotency, retries, and observability.
* Docker basics: comfortable building and running containers locally and following non-root image conventions where required.
* Kubernetes familiarity: understands health checks and resource limits at a basic level and can update Helm values with guidance.
* CI/CD familiarity: comfortable reading GitHub Actions workflow output and fixing common test and lint failures in PRs.

Cloud
  

* Practical experience with Microsoft Azure and/or AWS: deploying and operating product workloads, triaging logs and metrics, and reasoning about cost and scaling implications of service choices.
* Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform or equivalent): able to read existing modules, make scoped changes, and review changes with a security and cost lens. Valued, not required.

Generative AI and Agentic Systems
  

* Hands-on experience integrating AI-enabled features into applications: LLM calls, prompt and structured-output design, and streaming or human-in-the-loop patterns.
* Working knowledge of retrieval-augmented generation and vector search (for example pgvector), including chunking, embeddings, and retrieval quality at a practical level.
* Familiarity with agent orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, or equivalent) and with evaluation and regression-gate concepts for AI features.
* Treats AI coding assistants (Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent) as a co-pilot, not an autopilot: uses them to scaffold, refactor, and draft tests, but reads, understands, and revises every line before committing, and does not ship generated code they cannot fully explain.

General
  

* Operates as an engineer, not only a coder: frames the problem, weighs approaches, and designs for building; uses AI to accelerate execution, not to substitute for the thinking behind it.
* Builds for users: optimizes for analyst workflows and clarity, not just technical elegance.
* Delivers production-quality work: tests, observability, and documentation are part of the Definition of Done.
* Raises concerns early when requirements, contracts, or data models are unclear; seeks help rather than getting stuck.
* Communicates clearly, collaborates well across Product, Design, and Engineering, and grows toward providing technical guidance to others within the grade.
* This role follows a hybrid model, requiring in-office presence at least 1 day per week
